headline: NEW to scans -- Zelenskyy ready to freeze front lines, rejects ceding 25% of territory
dek: Zelenskyy said Ukraine is prepared to freeze combat operations along existing front lines to end the war, but firmly rejects proposals to give up 25% of Ukrainian territory to Russia. He said Ukraine received only 24 Patriot interceptor missiles from the US over the past three months, far below…
sources: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, interview with ABC News (Friday Oct 23), as carried by The Statesman (IANS), CGTN (Xinhua), Telangana Today, AP7am, Hans India, Lokmat Times
fault_line: Freeze the lines now and keep ~75% of Ukraine, or is any freeze without territory guarantees just surrender by instalments?

sections.what_happened: Zelenskyy said Ukraine is prepared to freeze combat operations along existing front lines to end the war, but firmly rejects proposals to give up 25% of Ukrainian territory to Russia. He said Ukraine received only 24 Patriot interceptor missiles from the US over the past three months, far below its average monthly requirement of 350, and that 30 ballistic missiles struck Kyiv on Thursday night alone. Trilateral Russia-Ukraine-US talks are scheduled for Abu Dhabi in the first half of November, focused on post-settlement security arrangements (Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov, Friday); Zelenskyy added the timing depends on the Russian side and that European representatives must also participate.
sections.what_verified: Primary-source interview (Zelenskyy's own statements) carried by Xinhua (T3) and IANS-based outlets; carriers of one interview are not independent corroboration of each other
sections.what_disputed: US media reports (as carried) say Washington is pressing Zelenskyy to make concessions and Trump blames Kyiv for stalled talks -- the freeze offer is made under that pressure, not as an agreed deal; no Russian acceptance of a frontline freeze is reported in these carriers. The 25% figure's proposer is not named in the carriers.
sections.why_matters: Zelenskyy just named the number that decides Abu Dhabi: 24 interceptors in three months against a need of 350 a month. Freeze the lines, keep the land -- but can Kyiv hold the lines with that maths?
sections.context: Background: NEW to scans (missed catch-up: ABC interview Friday, carried Oct 25 08:04 ) -- Zelenskyy ready to freeze front lines, rejects ceding 25% of territory; Patriot shortfall quantified; Abu Dhabi trilateral talks set for first half of November

totw_analysis: Our read: Zelenskyy just named the number that decides Abu Dhabi: 24 interceptors in three months against a need of 350 a month. Freeze the lines, keep the land -- but can Kyiv hold the lines with that maths? The fault line our audience is arguing over: Freeze the lines now and keep ~75% of Ukraine, or is any freeze without territory guarantees just surrender by instalments?
